The header line gives the landing site East longitude and latitude.  The date and 
times are given in UT.  e-lon and e-lat are the sub-Earth longitude and latitudes
derived from interpolating the Nautical Almanac lunar ephemeris data.  e-Alt and
e-Az are the Altitude and Azimuth of the Earth at that time.  s-lon and s-lat are
the sub-Solar longitude and latitudes derived from teh Nautical Almanac lunar
ephemeris.  s-Alt and s-Az are the Sun's Altitude and Azimuth at that time.  The 
landing and liftoff times are from "Apollo by the Numbers" by Orloff.  The EVA
start and end times are from "Apollo" by Orloff and Harland and generally refer to
depressurization and repressurization times.
